name: my-policy
description: A liveness check by video: the face held in an oval, then turned as asked, and read as live.

scripts.build: node -e "for (const d of ['dist', 'types']) require('node:fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })" && jco guest-types wit --world-name policy --variants-inline-cases -q -o types && tsc && componentize-qjs --wit wit --world policy --js dist/policy.js --module-root . --sync --opt-size -o dist/policy.component.wasm && enclavid policy embed dist/policy.component.wasm -o dist/policy.wasm
scripts.playground: npm run build && enclavid oci push dist/policy.wasm playground.enclavid.com/policies --quiet | enclavid session create --policy - --api https://playground.enclavid.com --applicants https://verify.enclavid.com
